intro: Small, self-contained models for building intuition about quantum states. Each tool runs entirely in your browser: nothing you set is sent anywhere, and every control has a keyboard equivalent.

tools.title: Single-qubit state visualizer
tools.summary: Point a qubit state on the Bloch sphere by dragging or by setting its two angles. Apply gates, measure the qubit, and read the amplitudes behind the picture.
features: Gates X, Y, Z, H, S, T

planned.title: Two-qubit states
planned.summary: Entangled and product states side by side, with the concurrence and the reduced single-qubit pictures.

planned.title: Measurement statistics
planned.summary: Sample outcomes from repeated measurements and compare the histogram with the predicted probabilities.

planned.title: Gate sequences
planned.summary: Build a short circuit on one or two qubits and follow the state through each step.
